mainText: Good morning. Futures are a touch lower: the S and P down about a quarter percent, the Dow down about half a percent, and the Nasdaq 100 roughly flat, following Thursday's AI selloff. The ten year Treasury yield is about four point nine nine percent. Premarket movers: A T and T, Verizon, and T Mobile are down more than three percent on a report SpaceX may launch a nationwide wireless carrier, while tower operators Crown Castle and American Tower are up eight and a half and five and a half percent on the same news. Bloom Energy is down more than three percent despite beating estimates. MaxLinear is up more than five percent on strong fourth quarter guidance. Western Digital is down about three percent after a beat, and Deckers Outdoor is falling on an earnings miss. Earnings today from American Express and S L B. The Fed decision is due October twenty eighth, with a hold expected.
